headline: Magic Carpet answers to your thumb
lede: The 1994 original armed your hands by clicking the HUD — now so does the phone. Tap a hand slot to cycle spells, tap the gold SPELLS tab for the seven-spell book, and the radar tells you when you're veiled.

notes.text: #1612 items 2+3 shipped via PR #1613: touch spellbook (slot cycles + spell tray + click-out) and the cyan radar sweep behind Invisibility, squash-merged to main 73f6c1e and live.

Spell routing lives in the pure sim (hudTap/TAP/TRAY/cycleL), so the entire touch path — equip, inert unlearned cells, never-cast dead strip, regen closing the book — is Node-provable: carpetcheck grew 38 → 49 gates, mutant-proven, 60/60 seeds unchanged.
Every equip now speaks: keys, pad or tap, the toast names the spell with a two-note blip.
#1612 stays open with the remainder (GL ghost shimmer, muffled veil audio, roster clones-to-volcano, village life, water/underwater) handed back to the QA lane.
